product-security-audit-controls.condition: Detect unsafe secret snippet disclosure, privileged pull_request_target review risk, unhashed release dependencies/SBOM gaps, and verify claimed symlink/path/subprocess safeguards.
evidence_sources: native scanner output and finding serialization
GitHub workflow YAML and effective permissions

openssf-best-practices-evidence.condition: Detect unavailable, unregistered, in-progress, passing, silver, gold, malformed, legacy, and permission-limited OpenSSF Best Practices states without asserting registration from repository text alone.
evidence_sources: OpenSSF Best Practices project API/current and legacy records

github-code-scanning-analysis-drift.condition: Detect missing or changed Code Scanning tool/category analyses between the default branch and pull-request head, including Trivy and Scorecard, with pagination, partial-permission, and API-failure semantics.

tenant-retention-and-audit-posture.condition: Detect absent, unsafe, stale, cross-tenant, non-idempotent, non-atomic, or tampered retention/audit controls and prove compliant policy state without exposing secrets.

scheduled-agent-workflow-governance.condition: Detect legacy Jules handoff, missing/mis-mapped NVIDIA NIM credentials, unpinned actions, unsafe event trust boundaries, excessive permissions, malformed selector outputs, and interference with independent review credentials.

authenticated-egress-destination-and-red.condition: Detect HTTPS downgrade, DNS time-of-check/time-of-use rebinding, mixed or non-global address answers, unsafe redirects, and cross-origin Authorization or Proxy-Authorization retention.
evidence_sources: resolver answer set and pinned connection destination

scanner-path-contract-and-performance.condition: Detect repeated scan-root normalization and regressions for str subclasses, Path values, dotfiles, separators, symlinks, single-file scans, and comment-scoped authentication deferrals; require benchmark evidence for speed claims.

scheduled-builder-runtime-contract.condition: Detect builder timeouts below two hours or above the reviewed bound while preserving cadence, PR-first selection, non-cancelling single-flight concurrency, trust boundary, action pin, and provider credential mapping.

opencode-review-gate-diagnostics.condition: Detect non-successful OpenCode review gates and distinguish dispatch/permission/auth, provider/rate-limit, reviewer execution, review-result publishing, expected policy block, manual/superseded cancellation, and unknown causes.
evidence_sources: provider response class with secret-safe redaction

strix-security-gate-diagnostics.condition: Detect non-successful Strix gates and distinguish scanner setup, provider/rate-limit/auth, scanner execution, result mapping, expected vulnerability-policy block, cancellation, and unknown causes.
evidence_sources: provider response class with secret-safe redaction

pr-evidence-publication-health.condition: Detect evidence/check publication failures separately from the upstream scanner result so a reporting defect never masquerades as a vulnerability or a clean scan.

coverage-evidence-control.category: expected control block and CI/workflow failure
coverage-evidence-control.condition: Detect missing, insufficient, malformed, stale, or unpublished coverage evidence and distinguish an expected quality-control block from infrastructure/provider cancellation.

trivy-filesystem-gate-diagnostics.condition: Detect Trivy filesystem scan failure/cancellation and distinguish setup or database errors, rate limits, scan execution errors, expected vulnerability/secret policy blocks, and superseded cancellation.

pull-request-metadata-policy.condition: Detect missing or invalid required PR metadata and distinguish a successful fail-closed governance block from validator execution or publication failure.

noema-review-gate-diagnostics.condition: Detect Noema review cancellation/failure and distinguish dispatch/auth, provider/rate-limit, reviewer execution, publication, expected policy block, and superseded cancellation.

codeql-analysis-gate-diagnostics.condition: Detect CodeQL analysis or merge-preview failure/cancellation and distinguish configuration/build/database/upload faults, expected alert policy blocks, and superseded cancellation.
evidence_sources: analysis database and SARIF upload state

native-appguardrail-gate-diagnostics.condition: Detect native AppGuardrail scan cancellation/failure and distinguish scanner execution, rules/configuration, expected finding block, and workflow cancellation.
